title: Haye Abbas Nahi Aye Na Aya Pani
body:
Haye sakina haye pyaas x5
Abbas na aye Abbas na aye x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhondti reh gaie kuzo me sakina pani x2
Abbas....
1) Rote dekha joh sakina ko toh bacho ne kaha x2
aisa lagta hai hame ab na milenga pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Roye behte hue pani ke liye jab gazi x2
Roya abbas ko maskize se behta pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Aks dikhta tha sakina ka kabhi asgar ka x2
Kaise abbas ne behte hue dekha pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Usko malum tha pyasi hai bhatiji meri x2
Paas hote hue muh se na lagaya pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Lashe abbas pe rote rahe pyase shabir x2 Aur mashkize pe karta raha girya pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Ghir gaya gazi ka sir naize se jab zalim ne x2
Samne bali sakina ke bahaya pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Haye abbas ki zainab ko bohot yaad aie x2
Fazl ne jab bhi madine me pilaya pani
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Bhul na jana alamdare wafa ki gurbat x2
Jab bhi pyaso ko sabilo se pilana pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
<<DIVIDER>>
9) Humne khud dekha hai zeeshan o raza ye manzar x2
Abhi abbas ki turbat se hai lipta pani x2
<<MINI>>
Haye abbas nahi aie na aya pani x4
